title: Voice Actors in Cartoons
subtitle: actor → show → character reuse
method_note: Population: cast credited on Animation titles with a voice signal (Wikidata occupation 'voice actor', IMDb characters containing '(voice)', or voice job string). Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50. Edges = shared Animation titles (≥2).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Men in Horror
subtitle: gender → role prominence → title profile
method_note: Population: male-coded cast (TMDB gender=male, else IMDb category=actor) credited on Horror movies/series with ≥3 horror titles (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Alluvial includes all genders to reveal imbalance. Edges = shared Horror titles (≥2).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Women in Horror
subtitle: gender → role prominence → title profile
method_note: Population: female-coded cast (TMDB gender=female, else IMDb category=actress) with ≥3 Horror credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance on shared Horror titles (≥2). Alluvial includes all genders to show imbalance.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Scream-Queen Web
subtitle: actress ↔ actress co-appearance in horror
method_note: Population: female-coded cast with ≥3 Horror credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance web (shared horror titles ≥2). Alluvial: top actresses → era → role band.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Bechdel Web
subtitle: cast across films that pass the Bechdel test
method_note: Population: cast credited on movies that fully pass the Bechdel test (rating=3 on bechdeltest.com; 5,105 titles in cache). Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50. Hero = co-appearance among people with ≥3 pass-film credits. Alluvial: gender → Bechdel band (0–3) → era across all rated titles.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Comedy × Horror
subtitle: crossover careers between laughs and screams
method_note: Population: people with ≥2 Horror and ≥2 Comedy title credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among crossover performers. Alluvial: gender → horror/comedy/horror-comedy lane → billing band.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Genre Bridges
subtitle: careers spanning two (or more) genres
method_note: Population: actors/actresses with ≥12 title-genre credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50) whose largest genre is <70% and second genre is ≥20% — careers that meaningfully span genres. Hero = co-appearance; node.bridge shows top two genres.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: One-Role Wonders
subtitle: person → genre concentration (≥90%)
method_note: Population: actors/actresses with ≥8 title-genre credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50) whose single largest genre accounts for ≥90% of those credits. Stratified: top N/8 people per dominant genre (genres with enough people), ranked by prominence (Σ votes/billing) rather than raw title count. Hero links connect people who share the same dominant genre; edge weight = min(prominence).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Long Careers
subtitle: 35+ year credited spans
method_note: Population: actors/actresses with ≥15 credits whose earliest and latest title years span ≥35 years (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among long-career peers.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Dubbing Multiverse
subtitle: voice actor → character fan-out
method_note: Population: people with a voice signal and ≥5 distinct character credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among prolific voice performers. Alluvial: top actors → medium → role-count band.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Repertory Companies
subtitle: tight multi-person troupes (≥3 shared titles)
method_note: Population: actors with ≥3 co-appearance partners who each share ≥3 titles (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50) — repertory / troupe careers. Edges require ≥3 shared titles.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Child Stars
subtitle: debut before age 12 → what happened next
method_note: Population: actors with known birthYear whose first credited title year minus birthYear is <12 (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50, ≥3 titles). Node color key: worked_past_25 (career continues to age ≥25).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Same Character Club
subtitle: Batmans, Bonds, Draculas — roles with 3+ faces
method_note: Population: actors who share a normalized primary character name played by 3–80 distinct people on titles with ≥500 votes (Adult excluded). Edges link people who share such characters.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Director's Muses
subtitle: actors with ≥4 titles under the same director
method_note: Population: actors with ≥4 titles under the same director (via title_crew; Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Node.top_director is their most-repeated director. Hero = co-appearance among muse actors.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Reunion Map
subtitle: pairs who reunited after ≥20 years apart
method_note: Population: actors with ≥8 credits spanning ≥20 years (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Edges kept only when first/last co-appearance gap ≥20 years (reunions).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Genre Drift
subtitle: early vs late career genre change
method_note: Population: actors with ≥15 credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50) whose dominant early-career genre (first third of years) differs from late-career genre (last third). Hero = co-appearance among drifters.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Comeback Trail
subtitle: ≥8-year hiatus then ≥5 credits after
method_note: Population: careers with a ≥8-year gap between consecutive credit years, then ≥5 distinct credit-years after the return (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among comeback peers.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Blockbuster Ensemble
subtitle: careers ≥50% in top-decile-votes titles
method_note: Population: actors with ≥8 credits where ≥50% of titles are in the global top decile of numVotes (Adult excluded, vote floor ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among blockbuster-heavy careers.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The B-Movie Loyalists
subtitle: careers ≥70% below-median-votes titles
method_note: Population: actors with ≥10 credits where ≥70% of titles are below the global median of numVotes (Adult excluded, vote floor ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among B-movie-loyal careers.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: National Cinema Bridges
subtitle: actors credited across ≥2 production regions
method_note: Population: actors with credits on titles appearing in ≥2 distinct title_akas regions (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among cross-regional careers.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Voice ↔ Face
subtitle: animation voice + live-action movie careers
method_note: Population: people with ≥3 Animation credits and ≥3 non-Animation movie credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Node.voice_ratio colors voice vs face balance. Hero = co-appearance.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Hyphenates
subtitle: actor-directors and actor-writers
method_note: Population: people whose primaryProfession includes actor/actress and director or writer (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50, ≥5 acting credits). Edges = co-appearance plus director→actor links among hyphenates when title_crew is available.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Franchise Nomads
subtitle: people in ≥3 distinct series / IP groups
method_note: Population: actors in ≥3 distinct franchises — parent series via title_episode and/or shared title-name prefixes (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among franchise hoppers.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Documentary Selves
subtitle: Self / Documentary credit ecosystems
method_note: Population: people with ≥8 category=self credits OR ≥8 Documentary-genre credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Hero = co-appearance among the documentary / talk-show ecosystem (min_shared=2).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Typecast Index
subtitle: careers defined by a repeated character name
method_note: Population: actors whose most common normalized character name appears ≥4 times (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50). Edges = co-appearance plus shared typecast archetype links.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Silent → Sound Survivors
subtitle: careers spanning the 1927–1929 transition
method_note: Population: actors with ≥1 credit in ≤1927 and ≥1 credit in ≥1929 (Adult excluded; vote floor relaxed to ≥20 or missing for silent-era coverage). Hero = co-appearance among transition survivors.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Horror Royalty Bloodlines
subtitle: horror regulars (men + women, ≥4 titles)
method_note: Population: male- and female-coded cast with ≥4 Horror credits (Adult excluded, numVotes ≥50) — scream-queen web extended across genders. Family edges skipped (no Wikidata relations in this build). Hero = co-appearance on shared Horror titles (≥2).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Acting Dynasties
subtitle: family trees woven with co-appearance
method_note: Population: people with Wikidata family links (spouse/child/sibling) when cache is present; otherwise high-volume multi-name careers as a weak surname proxy. Edges = co-appearance plus typed family links when available.
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Athletes to Actors
subtitle: wrestlers, martial artists, athletes who crossed over
method_note: Population: Wikidata occupations matching athlete/wrestler/martial-artist when cache is warm; otherwise prolific Action-genre careers (≥8 titles) as a physical-performance proxy. Edges = shared titles (≥2).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: The Drama School Webs
subtitle: RADA, Juilliard, and stage-school clusters
method_note: Population: Wikidata educated-at matching known drama schools when cache exists; otherwise prolific Drama-genre careers as a weak proxy. Edges = shared titles (≥2).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.

title: Award Season Cohorts
subtitle: award-linked careers woven by shared titles
method_note: Population: Wikidata P166 award recipients when cache exists; otherwise actors with median title rating ≥7.5 as a soft quality cohort. Edges = shared titles (≥2).
data_credit: IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets (datasets.imdbws.com); gender enrichment via TMDB where available; voice flags via Wikidata + IMDb character heuristics; Bechdel ratings where matched.
